messages:
harper_sales: Hey team — Prospect Orion Labs sent an RFI focused on deployment isolation, key management, and PoC acceptance. They want: capability matrix, a short PoC plan (2-3 weeks), sample infra config, and exact wording on HSM/KMS support. Deadline Tue noon. Link: https://orion.example/rfi.pdf @nina_se @sam_platform @tess_legal

nina_se: I'll take the capability matrix scoring + acceptance tests. Suggest using pass/partial/full for clarity, with a short notes column.

sam_platform: For PoC ops I recommend 2-week plan: week1 infra + smoke/perf, week2 tuning + acceptance. Recommend 3xA100 or 1xH100 depending on their perf goal. I'll include both costed options.

tess_legal: NDA needed before sharing internal runbooks. For HSM statement we can say: "HSM-backed key wrapping supported via customer-managed HSM (PKCS#11/KMIP) on Private deployments; enterprise engagement and SOW required." Approved.

harper_sales: Quick pricing bullets: Hosted gen $0.00095/token, embeddings $0.00035/token; Dedicated = committed monthly + overage; Private = license + infra + support. Offer a single 10% PoC credit if they convert within 30 days.

nina_se: Draft capability CSV snippet below — please edit scores/notes. I'll fill perf rows after sam's numbers.

```csv
capability,score,notes
model_catalog,full,"curated models + perf profiles"
streaming,full,"server-side streaming + SDKs"
private_deploy,full,"VPC & on-prem, KMS integrations"
batching,partial,"automatic batching; manual knobs exist"
quant_profiles,partial,"A100 q8 validated; H100 more testing"
```

sam_platform: Ops snippet for their infra team (they asked for YAML example):

```yaml
poc_environment:
  mode: dedicated
  nodes: 3
  gpu_options:
    - a100-80gb
    - h100-80gb
  autoscale: off
  runtime_image: redwood-runtime:2026-03
  networking:
    peering: true
    allowed_cidrs: ["172.16.0.0/12"]
```

harper_sales: @tess_legal ok to include the HSM line above and mention "requires SOW & field eng"?

tess_legal: Yes. Also add: "We do not warrant customer-provided HSM hardware; Redwood will provide integration support per SOW."

pack-bot: Draft bundle created: https://redwood.internal/sales/orion-rfi-draft (attachments: orion_capability_matrix.csv, poc_ops.yaml)

nina_se: I'll integrate sam's perf numbers and add acceptance checks: throughput >=1500 tok/s sustained on A100 option, 99th < 350ms.

sam_platform: I'll own infra during PoC and provide monitoring dashboards + cost estimate. nina, can you own validation tests?

nina_se: Yes. harper, I'll need the NDA signed to share any internal runbooks.

harper_sales: I'll coordinate NDA and assemble final bundle once I have perf + legal wording. Target send Tue noon. Thanks all :v:
